api.incremental_ungated_attempt: local Z seed and shared slope updates
api.paired_attempt: E,P,r,Q, fixed prepared circuit, nonzero a,b -> original,incremental,six cells
api.ungated_attempt: actual original strict fixed L implementation embedded; no reference imports

counter_semantics.M: distinct legal NONZERO converted scalars submitted to both public checks; zero verified and counted separately, never included in M
counter_semantics.allocation: setup/common, query, reduction/conversion, list wrapper separately; six cells share physical trace
counter_semantics.memory: abstract payload counts, not native RSS; unmetered interpreter/container/I/O disclosed
counter_semantics.qualification: raw actual emitted counters; no independent replay or timing qualification
counter_semantics.streaming: JSONL rows flush incrementally; only one trace and its six bounded cells retained; interpreter/RSS/I/O and complete allocation not metered; no independent counter replay qualification
counter_semantics.word_count: 2**e * sum(comb(L-e,j), j=0..min(t,L-e)); complete deterministic list after success

enumeration_order.cap: only actual e>erasure_cap; zero words; cap metadata retained; t0.e0 status UNDEFINED agrees original
enumeration_order.word_order: erasure assignments lexicographic product(0,1); within assignment increasing flip weight; within weight lexicographic combinations of increasing defined query indices

job_schema.kind_policy: calibration traces original only; confirmation primary circuit2.a1 paired original/incremental

public_inputs.nonce: 64 lowercase hex; public coordinate sampler, no k generation
public_inputs.static_config: future frozen stage seeds/caps/exclusions/controls/source pins required

record_semantics.completion_files: map basename to sha256, bytes, records; excludes completion itself
record_semantics.counts: sparse maps of operation-name to nonnegative integer; absent operation means zero; schema counter maps permit arbitrary string keys
record_semantics.fixture_scope: sample records only existing F11 witness; zero hash placeholders explicitly not scientific provenance
record_semantics.memory: abstract retained payload only; no RSS or complete native allocation qualification
record_semantics.nullability: candidate scalars/checks are null for empty intervals; predicate bit null on UNDEFINED; reason null on success; recovered scalar null unless equations pass; setup_reason null for ready setup; fixture sampling/draw null means disclosed fixed input, not random sampling
record_semantics.operational_failure: intents persist before trace work; exception recorded summary errors and incomplete completion; absent planned records remain absent and counts show gaps

reference_semantics.M: distinct converted nonzero x values submitted to both public equations; zero excluded; duplicates excluded
reference_semantics.conversion: x=a*b^-1*k mod r; both [k]prepared_base=[b]Q and [x]P=Q run regardless of first result
reference_semantics.uniform_reference: host only, independent uniform without-replacement nonzero candidates; budget min(M,r-1); saturation M>=r-1 checks all nonzero candidates
reference_semantics.zero: legal interval k=0 and converted x=0 checked with both actual equations and all costs; retained in words and zero_candidate_checks

seal_integration.host_requirement: collect all bytes, verify seals, quiesce/termination ACK before host log/orbit/BSGS/uniform/reference work
seal_integration.worker_outputs: engine-completion binds output hashes and terminal complete/incomplete status
